summary: Thunk that calls BooleanToIntConversion on the function pointer stored at 0x0054EAD0 and returns its result. The referenced global carries the name MainLoopHeartbeat1024 and is read only.

operations.description: Call BooleanToIntConversion with the value at 0x0054EAD0 (global MainLoopHeartbeat1024) as its integer argument.
Return the result of the BooleanToIntConversion call.

unresolved: Whether the global at 0x0054EAD0 holds a function pointer to a main-loop heartbeat (per its label) or a plain value, and why it is cast through BooleanToIntConversion, is not confirmed.
The behavior and side effects of BooleanToIntConversion at 0x00587B3E are not examined here.
